messages:
sam: FYI I hit a weird UX bug in the Go SDK generator around ctx handling + streaming. repro in our onboarding sample that does auth-refresh during startup.
emily: can you share the smallest repro and sdk version?
sam: vendored v0.14.0-rc1. minimal snippet:
```
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 40*time.Millisecond)
g, err := client.NewGenerator(ctx, modelID, opts...)
// immediately call g.Stream() or g.Next()
```
when ctx cancels while the handshake is in-flight constructor returns error but a reader goroutine remains. observed in dev machine and CI where network is slow.
aj: sounds like the read loop is started before handshake completion and there's no cancellation hook bound to the constructor path.
emily: interesting — py/js SDKs gate the reader on handshake success. go probably started the goroutine early for perf but didn't wireup the cancel.
sam: locally I patched NewGenerator to not spawn the reader until handshakeFuture.Done() and that removed the leak. also added a select { case <-ctx.Done(): return nil } before starting anything.
aj: good. do we want to change constructor semantics so ctx is strictly handshake-only vs lifecycle? currently ambiguous.
emily: API parity is important: JS/py treat constructor ctx as lifecycle for streams, but our docstring for Go is vague. changing signature to accept two contexts would be breaking.
sam: propose three steps: 1) ship non-breaking guard (delay reader + ctx check) + unit test that simulates cancel during handshake; 2) clarify docs about what ctx controls; 3) open an RFC if we want separate lifecycle ctx or an explicit Start/Close API.
aj: +1. add a fuzz test that artificially stalls handshake and asserts no goroutines remain after constructor returns. also add an integration sample that shows recommended pattern for auth refresh.
emily: for the sample app, we should show a pattern where auth refresh happens before calling generator methods, or using a background ctx for long-lived generators. show both patterns.
sam: I'll draft the PR with test + minimal fix. PR title: "go: guard generator reader on handshake cancel (fix leak)". cc @aj @emily.
ciaran-bot: CI queued for PR #6001 — running unit + integration suites (one allowed retry for flaky jobs) :robot_face:
aj: follow-up: after patch merges, we should sweep internal sample apps and the onboarding repo to ensure they don't rely on the old behaviour. open a small follow-up chore.
emily: also update the migrate guide: "generator ctx semantics" so customers know how to handle short-lived ctx when instantiating generators.
sam: will send PR in ~45m. thanks for the quick triage. :thumbsup:
